subject: Orchid Health — Hosted API integration workshop: architecture & invoke patterns
messages:
From: Olivia Barnes <olivia@orchidhealth.com>
To: Nikhil Sharma <nikhil_sharma@redwood.com>
Cc: Samantha Jones <samantha.jones@orchidhealth.com>
Date: Mon, 7 Dec 2026 15:22:00 -0800
Subject: Hosted API architecture workshop (Orchid)

Hi Nikhil,

Thanks again for the product overview last week — the Orchid engineering team is keen to move to a technical architecture review so we can scope a pilot. We'd like to cover: SDK options (server vs client-side), streaming behavior for long documents, tool/function-calling patterns (retrieval + actions), auth/service account setup, and network egress considerations.

Proposed slot options (PST):
- Tue Dec 8, 10:00–11:30
- Tue Dec 8, 14:00–15:30

I've attached a short outline and our preliminary integration questions (arch-outline.pdf). Attendees likely: Raj (eng lead), Hannah (backend), Samantha (security). Can you confirm who from Redwood should join? Also can you share any pre-reads or network/integration prerequisites we should prepare?

Zoom (tentative): https://zoom.us/j/9876543210?pwd=orchid-arch

Appreciate it — Olivia

--
Olivia Barnes
Head of Platform Integrations
Orchid Health
Phone: +1 415-555-0142
From: Nikhil Sharma <nikhil_sharma@redwood.com>
To: Olivia Barnes <olivia@orchidhealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 7 Dec 2026 16:05:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Hosted API architecture workshop (Orchid)

Hi Olivia — thanks, and great summary. Nikhil here. Happy to run the session. Proposed agenda (45–60m tech + 30m Q&A):

1) Quick architecture map and hosting modes (hosted API vs Dedicated vs Private) – 10m
2) SDKs and streaming patterns (client vs server, token/latency tradeoffs) – 15m
3) Invoke patterns & function/tool-calling with retrieval – 20m
4) Network/auth prerequisites, data retention & auditing – 15m
5) Next steps / pilot checklist – 10m

From Redwood: I'll join, and I'll ask Marissa (runtime lead) and Monica (solutions/ops) to attend for the SDK/ops bits.

Slot preference: we can do Tue Dec 8 at 14:00 PST. If your team prefers the morning slot we can accommodate but prefer 14:00. Please confirm.

Pre-reads and items to bring:
- sample prompt/workflow you intend to run (so we can simulate token/latency)
- a basic network diagram or egress policy (if you have special VPC/firewall rules)
- list of required tool integrations/actions you expect the model to call (docs, APIs, webhooks)

I'll attach a quick checklist (MVP-integration-checklist.xlsx) in the calendar invite and share a short Confluence brief afterwards.

If you want a short run-through of our streaming SDK examples ahead of time, Monica can share a snippet.

Thanks — Nikhil

--
Nikhil Sharma
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
nikhil_sharma@redwood.com
From: Raj Patel <raj@orchidhealth.com>
To: Nikhil Sharma <nikhil_sharma@redwood.com>, Olivia Barnes <olivia@orchidhealth.com>
Cc: Hannah Cole <hannah@orchidhealth.com>, Samantha Jones <samantha.jones@orchidhealth.com>
Date: Tue, 8 Dec 2026 09:12:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Hosted API architecture workshop (Orchid)

Hi Nikhil — thanks for the agenda. 14:00 PST works for us and we've added a couple of specifics we'd like to validate in the session:

- Expected throughput for a batched clinical-ops workflow (50 concurrent sessions)
- How prefix/KV cache behaves across short-lived sessions
- Example of function/tool calling to hit an internal patient-data service (we'll bring a sanitized example)

Attendees confirmed: Raj (me), Hannah (backend), Sam (security).

Attachment: network-diagram.png (sanitized egress path)

Olivia — please go ahead and send the calendar invite and Zoom. Looking forward to it.

Hi everyone — quick update. I just ran into a calendar conflict for Tue 14:00 PST (unexpected exec review). Apologies. Could we shift the workshop 30 minutes later to 14:30–16:00 PST on Dec 8? If 14:30 is tight for Orchid, we can also move to Wed Dec 9, 10:00–11:30 PST.

If you prefer we can still run at 14:00 with Marissa leading the SDK/streaming portion and I can join remotely for the Q&A only — but I prefer shifting so I can cover invoke patterns end-to-end.

Updated Zoom: https://zoom.us/j/9876543210?pwd=orchid-arch&start=1430

Also quick note: if Orchid is planning to test with real PHI during the pilot, please flag that now so we can plan for Private deployment options and KMS integrations in the follow-up notes.

Thanks and sorry for the churn — Nikhil
